parameters.query: WITH detected AS (INSERT INTO helpdesk.sla_breaches (ticket_id) SELECT t.ticket_id FROM helpdesk.tickets t WHERE t.status IN ('received','processing','routed','manual_review') AND t.sla_deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.sla_deadline < now() ON CONFLICT (ticket_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING ticket_id), events AS (INSERT INTO helpdesk.ticket_events (ticket_id,event_type,actor,correlation_id,metadata) SELECT t.ticket_id,'sla_breached','workflow:helpdesk-sla-monitor',t.correlation_id,jsonb_build_object('sla_deadline',t.sla_deadline) FROM detected d JOIN helpdesk.tickets t ON t.ticket_id=d.ticket_id), outbox AS (INSERT INTO helpdesk.notification_outbox (ticket_id,idempotency_key,notification_type) SELECT d.ticket_id,encode(digest('sla_breach:' || d.ticket_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),'sla_breach' FROM detected d ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING outbox_id,ticket_id) SELECT outbox_id,ticket_id FROM outbox;
